fields.terrain: mostly plains with some hills and low mountains
fields.hazards: outside usual path of hurricanes and other tropical storms
fields.farm: chicken, fruits, coconuts, citrus fruits, maize, oranges, plantains, eggs, taro, mangoes/guavas
fields.exports: natural gas, alcohols, ammonia, crude petroleum, iron reductions
fields.industries: petroleum and petroleum products, liquefied natural gas, methanol, ammonia, urea, steel products, beverages, food processing, cement, cotton textiles
fields.languages: English (official), Trinidadian Creole English, Tobagonian Creole English, Caribbean Hindustani (a dialect of Hindi), Trinidadian Creole French, Spanish, Chinese
fields.religions: Protestant 32.1% (Pentecostal/Evangelical/Full Gospel 12%, Baptist 6.9%, Anglican 5.7%, Seventh Day Adventist 4.1%, Presbyterian/Congregational 2.5%, other Protestant 0.9%), Roman Catholic 21.6%…
fields.legal: English common law; Supreme Court reviews legislative acts
fields.military: generally 18-24 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; no conscription
